proposed_rules.trigger: On a download/template page, a full-width template preview image or screenshot ([2x1]/[3x1]/[3x2], sometimes [bg:image]) is immediately followed by an 'Install Free Template App' button.
proposed_rules.decision: Model the preview image and the install CTA as ONE composite block (image cell + CTA cell), not as a separate image block plus a standalone CTA/default-content link.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternatives: (a) split into a generic image block and a separate CTA link, which would obscure that the image and the button perform one paired action (install this exact template); (b) fold it into the numbered-benefits grid above it, rejected because it is a visually distinct zone with a different content shape (single media item, not a repeating card grid).

provenance.evidence: C77 rc1c2c3 [3x2][bg:image] preview + rc1c2c3c3 [bg:color] 'Install Free Template App'

proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width '[2x1] Get Started with Knack's ___' banner naming the specific template/app, positioned directly before the footer on template/download pages.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as a reusable CTA banner block parametrized by template name, not page-unique free text.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical structural position, size class, and wording pattern recur across all sampled download-template pages, indicating a shared component rather than one-off copy.
